description: This file defines default configuration functions for Kubernetes components, including leader election, client connection, and debugging configurations, with functions setting recommended default values.

methods.name: RecommendedDefaultLeaderElectionConfiguration
methods.description: Sets default values for LeaderElectionConfiguration, including lease duration, renew deadline, retry period, resource lock, and leader election flag.

methods.name: RecommendedDefaultClientConnectionConfiguration
methods.description: Sets default values for ClientConnectionConfiguration, including content type, QPS, and burst.

methods.name: RecommendedDebuggingConfiguration
methods.description: Sets default value for DebuggingConfiguration, enabling profiling.

methods.name: NewRecommendedDebuggingConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a new DebuggingConfiguration with recommended defaults.
